On Target: John Crossman, Author, Speaker, Real Estate Expert, FAMU and Bethune-Cookman Trustee

On Target
05-03-2026 • 14 minutos
In this episode of On Target, host Rosanna Catalano sits down with John Crossman—speaker, consultant, bestselling author, real estate expert, and Florida A&M University and Bethune-Cookman Board of Trustee member—for a wide-ranging conversation about service, success, and creating lasting impact.
John shares the inspiring story of his father, Reverend Ken Crossman, a civil rights leader dubbed the "bridge builder" by the Sun-Sentinel in 1970 for his work bringing communities together.
Decades later, John and a dedicated team—including the attorneys at Gunster—worked to honor that legacy by naming an actual bridge in Central Florida after his father, a powerful symbol during a time

unique strengths of Florida's diverse university system.
John also discusses his book, "Career Killers, Career Builders: The book every Millennial needs to read", a guide for young professionals
